lines.text: Two hours of the same slides!
I was bored stiff in that class.

data.define: Used when something is very dull.

example.text: I was bored stiff in that class.

misuse.text: Don't tell the speaker you're 'bored stiff'.

data.l1: muerto de aburrimiento; aburrido hasta la muerte
data.l1_hook: Dos horas de las mismas diapositivas, estoy "bored stiff".
data.l1_ex: Yo estaba "bored stiff" en esa clase.
